flags: No byway or tourism-agency description is cached. The designation and highway network have secondary support, but official rationale, driving time and detailed road character are unavailable.
Catalog lengths (484 miles and 664.2 mapped miles) cannot be verified in the cache and are omitted. The overview follows one west-to-east corridor through a branching network.

Los Adaes dates conflict within its article: the lead gives capital status through 1773, while the body describes headquarters moving in 1768 and San Antonio becoming capital in 1772; mission closure dates also differ. Omit those disputed dates, retain the 1773 forced relocation.

Fort Jesup’s article has chronological problems in its account of Texas and the Mexican-American War. Omit that causal account. Keep restored original kitchen distinct from reconstructed officers’ quarters.

No current motifs were supplied. Front Street’s restoration is undated; removed current copy’s “lately.” Natchitoches’s oldest-settlement claim would require the European qualifier found in the history section and is omitted. Site designation does not establish current opening arrangements.
